{{Quote|To the Chamber of Judgment, summon Skywalker and his Padawan.|Yoda|<ref name="The Wrong Jedi">{{TCW|The Wrong Jedi}}</ref>}}
The '''Chamber of Judgment''' was a room within the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] that acted as a courtroom for the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. Around [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], the apprehended [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] was bought to this room for her trial. The [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] that tried her were [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] and Jedi Masters [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]], [[Shaak Ti/Legends|Shaak Ti]] and [[Ki-Adi-Mundi/Legends|Ki-Adi-Mundi]]. Tano's master, [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], was present at the trial along with two of the [[Jedi Temple Guard/Legends|Temple Guards]]. Tano was found guilty, and was stripped of her battlefield privileges as well as her [[Padawan braid/Legends|Padawan braid]] signifying the loss of her [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] status and was expelled from the Jedi Order.
